name: Axiom Systems Neural Interface Diagnostic Tool NIDT-3
product_name: Axiom Systems Neural Interface Diagnostic Tool NIDT-3
description: A handheld diagnostic device that assesses the health and integrity of a neural interface without requiring medical facility access. The NIDT-3 connects to the interface's external diagnostic port and performs a comprehensive assessment — checking processor function, memory integrity, connection quality with neural tissue, firmware version, and security status. The tool identifies hardware faults, firmware corruption, unauthorized modifications, and potential security compromises. Axiom designed it for field technicians maintaining neural interfaces in environments far from clinical facilities.

specifications.info: memory; neural connection; firmware; security; firmware corruption; unauthorized mods; unauthorized access detection
specifications.output: Detailed report to linked device or neural interface

story_hooks: An NIDT-3 scan revealed that a patient's neural interface had been modified with firmware not matching any known version — the modification was installed without the patient's knowledge and its function is unclear.

NIDT-3 tools have been modified to inject diagnostic payloads rather than just reading them — the diagnostic connection has been weaponized to compromise the neural interface during what appears to be a routine checkup.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, pen-sized diagnostic wand with a tapered grip and reinforced tip connector. Resembles a high-end stylus crossed with clinical instrumentation. The device has a distinctly medical precision aesthetic—clean lines, no unnecessary bulk.
physical_description.weight_description: Ultra-lightweight (150g), easily pocketable, designed for one-handed operation
physical_description.primary_material: Aircraft-grade aluminum alloy chassis with medical-grade polycarbonate grip section
physical_description.finish: Brushed satin metallic on barrel, textured rubberized grip with micro-knurling for moisture resistance
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray body with white accent trim; soft blue indicators along the length
physical_description.interface_elements: Micro-LED status ring near the tip (green/yellow/red diagnostics), single capacitive activation button on grip, recessed micro-USB-C charging port at base, holographic data projection lens at tapered tip
distinctive_features: Diagnostic port connector with spring-loaded alignment guides
Soft blue breathing LED during active scan
Holographic micro-display projects results onto nearby surface or AR overlay
Integrated thermal dissipation vanes along barrel
AXIOM SYSTEMS embossed logo with serial number above grip
Faint cybernetic circuit-pattern etched into grip section
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: AXIOM SYSTEMS NIDT-3 printed in white sans-serif on upper barrel; Φ 2,800-4,200 price range indicator; regulatory certification marks for GLMZ medical standard compliance
physical_description.condition_typical: Carried in dedicated quick-draw wrist holster or lab coat pocket; minor micro-scratches on barrel from diagnostic port insertions; faint bioelectric residue patterns on connector tip from recent interface checks
